note: After the original English description by Sands (1959) (new species Amitermes acinacifer sp. nov.), describing the soldier and worker, the alate recorded in the original as Unknown; the measurements are given as ranges and means, and only the ranges are adopted here. The pronotum length entry of the original is misaligned by the OCR and has not been adopted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is rather small, with a very short frontal tube and weak mandibular marginal teeth; most similar to Amitermes peruanus, which is larger and has a larger marginal tooth on the left mandible. The alate is not known in detail.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to yellowish brown, mandibles pale brown to chestnut brown, antennae and legs pale yellow, the rest yellowish white (the abdomen taking colour from the gut contents). Head in dorsal view slightly longer than wide, sides curved, posterior margin regularly rounded; in lateral view continuously curved from the fontanelle to the occiput, the anterior curvature shallower. Mandibles slender and nearly straight, slightly elbow-shaped, incurved at the apex; the tooth lies within the basal 1/3, projecting, erect and slightly directed forwards; the inner margin from the base of the tooth to the apex strongly undulate. Antennae 13—14-segmented, segments 2, 4 and 5 subequal in length, segment 3 about half as long (or segments 2 and 5 subequal, segments 3 and 4 subequal and half as long as the former). Head capsule sparsely hairy; anterior margin of the pronotum regularly curved, not concave; anterior surface of the fore coxa with 3—4 short, stout spines in the middle; the other legs with numerous spines and long hairs. Measurements: head length 0.93—0.97, maximum head width 0.76—0.82, mandible base width 0.61—0.63, head thickness 0.61—0.64, pronotum width 0.47—0.49, hind tibia length 0.70—0.78.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head yellow, antennae and the rest yellowish white; the third marginal tooth of the left mandible usually does not project beyond the cutting edge between it and the first marginal tooth.
